The following is a list of '''patch v13.00''''s changes and updates to ''[[VALORANT]]''.

Full context and other developer notes about the updates may be found in the [[Patch Notes/13.00/Archive|official notes]].
{{TOCright}}
==Map Updates==
===[[Summit]]===
*{{ui|Added}} Summit added to all active modes

===Map Rotation===
*{{ui|Removed}} [[Fracture]] and [[Pearl]] rotated out.
*{{ui|Added}} [[Summit]] and [[Sunset]] rotated in.

==Modes Updates==
===[[Retake]]===
*{{ui|Added}} New mode added for a limited time

===[[Competitive]]===
*{{ui|Adjustment}} RR calculations adjusted in cases of consistently winning matches to feel less stuck
*'''PC-ONLY''': {{ui|Buff}} Average ranks for either team in a match more likely to be within 1 sub-tier of each other

===[[Premier]]===
*Stage V26A4 to commence on July 1
*Playoffs on August 16 (First round August 15 for Contender/Invite Divisions)

===Summit Queue===
*{{ui|Added}} Swiftplay-format Summit-only queue available for 7 days.

==Other Updates==
===General===
*{{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug where if a player was spectating an ally who got an Ace or Clutch in the previous round, the pre-round commend VO could become directional for the spectator.
* {{ui|Bugfix}} Fixed a bug where the bottom HUD color for Signature and Ultimate abilities would be an incorrect color after Side Swap or Overtime.
===Client===
*{{ui|Added}}Inbox is now live, featuring notifications for:
**[[Gifting]] updates
**[[Premier]] updates
**RR refunds
**Reporter feedback
**[[Act]] Introduction messages
